operations.name: Patron Balance Threshold Queries
operations.description: The system shall allow an authorized staff user to query patron accounts whose balances exceed a threshold amount specified for each query. The result shall identify the patron accounts meeting the threshold and support review of accounts requiring attention. The query shall not use a fixed threshold.

operations.name: Hold Placement Source Reporting
operations.description: The system shall record and report the placement method for each hold, with supported methods including staff desk, public computer inside a library, and remote placement. Reports shall provide both individual hold records with their placement method and aggregate hold counts grouped by placement method and reporting period. This shall allow authorized staff users to analyze hold placement patterns without combining distinct methods.

operations.name: Separate Check-In and Renewal Records and Reporting
operations.description: The system shall record renewal transactions separately from check-in transactions and expose separate date and time values for each. Reports shall distinguish check-ins from renewals and provide separate counts and timestamps so circulation staff and analysts can verify each transaction type independently.

operations.name: Library Comparison Reports
operations.description: The system shall provide a common report view for comparing selected metrics across multiple libraries for the same reporting period. The view shall label each library, metric, and period and display results together so directors and library managers can identify differences without assembling separate reports. The measures and comparison period shall be selectable from the report's supported criteria.

operations.name: Missing and Damaged Item Reports
operations.description: The system shall provide reports of missing and damaged items by library, including counts grouped by library and item-level results. Authorized staff users shall be able to select date ranges and filter by status, including missing, lost, and long overdue, and review item condition notes. Reports shall support auditing and collection decisions, including identifying items with repeated incidents for replacement or relocation.

operations.name: Last-Item Identification and Pre-Deletion Reports
operations.description: The system shall provide a report identifying items that are the last item within a selected library, library system, or consortium scope. Authorized staff users shall be able to review current last-item status and use the report in a pre-deletion workflow before an authorized purge. Results shall provide item identifiers and actionable details to support cataloging, preservation, and external-catalog decisions.

operations.name: Transfer Candidate Query and Preparation
operations.description: The system shall provide a query capability for identifying candidate items for transfer, including criteria such as item location and circulation inactivity. Authorized staff users shall be able to review the query results and prepare a transfer batch from selected candidates; selection of individual results shall use the reusable result-selection capability in REQ-DATAQ-017. This shall combine query-driven discovery with controlled preparation of transfer batches.

operations.name: Select Records From Query Results
operations.description: The system shall allow authorized staff users to select individual records or items from query results for a targeted action. The selection shall be limited to the results the staff user chooses, rather than automatically including the complete query result. Transfer workflows and other supported targeted actions shall use this reusable selection capability.

operations.name: Save and Reuse Queries and Report Templates
operations.description: The system shall allow report users to save queries and report templates for repeated use, including recurring monthly work. Report users shall be able to share saved queries or templates with other authorized staff users when permitted by assigned roles. Changes shall be governed by the applicable template permissions; conversion between saved queries and report templates and version history are not required by this capability.

operations.name: Scheduled Report Frequencies
operations.description: The system shall allow report users to run a report as soon as possible or schedule it to run hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. The selected frequency shall be available when configuring the report schedule, and hourly scheduling shall be supported alongside the other listed frequencies.

operations.name: Item Status Conversion Report
operations.description: The system shall provide a report to assist authorized staff users with batch conversion of item statuses. The report shall identify the items and their current statuses relevant to the intended status change, allowing staff to review the items before performing the batch conversion. This requirement covers the status-conversion report, not authorization or execution safeguards for the conversion operation.

operations.name: Report and Capacity Data Export Formats
operations.description: The system shall allow report users to export report outputs and capacity data in CSV, Excel, and HTML formats. Capacity data, including capacity views, shall be exportable in CSV or Excel for use in spreadsheet applications. Report users shall be able to select an available format appropriate to their intended use.

operations.name: Create, Edit, and Version Report Templates
operations.description: The system shall allow report administrators to create report templates, edit their saved configuration, and maintain versions when a template is changed. Report administrators shall be able to make templates available to report users subject to assigned permissions. This requirement covers the saved template lifecycle; cloning is covered by REQ-RPTMG-017, and run-specific changes are covered by REQ-RPTMG-037.

operations.name: Clone Report Templates
operations.description: The system shall allow a report user with the required permission to clone an existing report template and save the clone as a separate template for further modification. Cloning shall not alter the original template. This requirement covers creation of a new template from an existing one; editing and versioning the saved template are covered by REQ-RPTMG-014, and run-specific changes are covered by REQ-RPTMG-037.

operations.name: Run Report Templates With Optional Run-Time Changes
operations.description: The system shall allow report users to run a report template as saved or change supported criteria for an individual run without changing the saved template. Access to templates and run-time changes shall follow assigned permissions. This requirement covers execution and run-specific changes; saved template creation, editing, and versioning are covered by REQ-RPTMG-014, and cloning is covered by REQ-RPTMG-017.

operations.name: Reporting Interface Options
operations.description: The system shall provide three reporting interfaces: predefined report templates, on-demand reports configured for a specific run, and open-template reporting. The interface shall identify the selected mode and provide the controls needed to run or configure it; open-template reporting shall support ad hoc reporting by advanced report users. Acceptance testing shall verify that a report user can run a predefined template, change run-time criteria for an on-demand report, and create or configure an open template.

operations.name: Role-Based Access Control
operations.description: The system shall control access to authorized system and report functions through configurable roles and security groups. Administrators shall be able to assign roles or groups to authorized staff users, and permissions shall be determined from those assignments at login regardless of login method. Permissions shall provide access appropriate to each authorized staff user's responsibilities.

operations.name: Normalized, Isolated Reporting Architecture
operations.description: The system shall support reporting queries over normalized relational data and shall not require a denormalized copy of production data. Reporting workloads shall be isolated from production transactions using a read-only replica, normalized historical store, snapshots, or an equivalent architecture; reporting access shall not modify source records. The implementation shall document data synchronization and reconciliation, workload isolation, and the data-through timestamp, which each report shall identify. Denormalized reporting stores are not permitted by this requirement.
operations.priority_rationale: Reporting isolation and historical-data handling are requested across multiple sources, and database impact is identified as a significant concern; a normalized architecture provides a clear, consistent constraint.

operations.name: Client Platform and Browser Compatibility
operations.description: The system shall be accessible through a web browser or a Windows-compatible client. When browser access is used, the system shall support Microsoft Internet Explorer version 6.0 and later and Mozilla Firefox version 2.0 and later. Acceptance testing shall verify access using the specified minimum browser versions where those platforms are part of the deployment baseline.

operations.name: Linux and Solaris Server Compatibility
operations.description: The system shall be deployable and operable on Linux or Solaris servers. Supported platform constraints include Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5 and Solaris 10 on SPARC hardware, as specified by the sources. The approved deployment baseline shall identify the selected server platform and verify that the system's supported functionality operates on it.

operations.name: De-Identified Aggregate Transaction Retention
operations.description: The system shall retain monthly and annual aggregate transaction information only after it has been de-identified so it cannot identify a patron. Retention and deletion of these aggregates shall follow the applicable approved retention policy and legal requirements; this requirement does not establish indefinite retention or override a legal hold. The system shall record retention-policy changes and any resulting deletion actions.

operations.name: Financial Data Retention Policy
operations.description: The system shall enforce configurable retention periods by financial data category. Where the approved legal or policy requirement specifies a seven-year audit period, the system shall apply that period to the applicable records; other categories shall use their approved periods. De-identified aggregate transaction information shall be governed by the applicable policy and law, not assumed to be exempt from deletion. An authorized legal hold shall suspend deletion for affected records, and the system shall record policy changes and deletion actions. The approved retention schedule shall identify the governing authority and applicable data categories before compliance acceptance.

operations.name: Privacy-Preserving Transaction Archive
operations.description: The system shall archive transaction data in a form that protects patron privacy and follows the retention periods established for applicable data categories in REQ-ACCT-011. The archive shall not retain personally identifiable patron information where the approved privacy policy requires de-identification. The project compliance baseline shall identify the governing state-law or approved policy provision and its retention period before compliance acceptance; this requirement does not introduce an unspecified period such as “X years.”

operations.name: Accounting and Audit Compliance
operations.description: The system shall support financial reports and archived financial data in compliance with applicable accounting and governmental auditing requirements. Before compliance acceptance, the project shall identify the governing accounting standards and applicable state, county, and municipal audit provisions in a controlled compliance register, with exact document, section, and version references. Acceptance testing shall verify the applicable reporting and retention obligations against that approved register.

operations.name: Privacy-Protected Transaction Archive
operations.description: The system shall archive transaction data in a form that protects patron privacy as required by the applicable law and approved privacy policy. Before compliance acceptance, the project shall identify the governing law or policy, including exact document, section, and version references, in a controlled compliance register. The archive shall support approved demographic statistics without exposing personally identifiable patron information, and acceptance testing shall verify those privacy controls against the register.

operations.name: Aged Debt Report Field Decision
operations.description: This item is a stakeholder decision, not a current software requirement: stakeholders shall approve and document the additional fields required for the Aged Debt report before the report enhancement is specified. The decision record shall identify each field, its definition, source data, and expected output behavior. No implementation or acceptance claim for additional fields is made until that controlled decision is approved.

operations.name: Versioned Report Definition Catalog
operations.description: The system shall support the report definitions in a controlled, versioned report catalog that identifies each report, its fields, filters, scope, and output rules, including the definitions formerly referenced as Appendix A and Appendix B. Before acceptance testing, the project shall include the catalog's controlled artifact identifier and approved version in the specification. Acceptance testing shall verify every definition in that fixed version; changes to the catalog require an approved version update.

operations.name: Approved Report Type Coverage
operations.description: The system shall provide every report type in the controlled report-gap register approved for the project. Before acceptance testing, the project shall identify the register by controlled artifact identifier and version and ensure it specifies each report type's required fields, filters, scope, and output rules. Acceptance testing shall verify each entry in that fixed baseline; report types not in the approved version are outside this requirement.

operations.name: Board and External Reports
operations.description: The system shall provide the predefined reports for library boards and external reporting needs, including the Georgia Annual Report and the Application for State Aid. Before acceptance testing, the project shall identify the controlled, approved, versioned report catalog and applicable form versions, including required fields, calculations, reporting periods, and output rules. Acceptance testing shall verify each report against that fixed baseline; changes require an approved version update.

operations.name: Delayed Transfer Alerts
operations.description: The system shall notify configured recipients when a transfer has no recorded arrival after its configured delay threshold or when a transfer operation records a failure or invalid transfer status. Configuration shall specify the delay threshold, recipient roles or addresses, and notification channel; the system shall identify the affected item, sending and destination libraries, detected condition, and detection time. The system shall retry a failed notification and retain its delivery status until delivery succeeds or an authorized staff user is alerted to intervene. Acceptance testing shall verify each condition, configured recipient and channel, and failed-delivery handling.
operations.priority_rationale: The alert is a useful operational capability requested in one source, but the evidence does not establish a critical or mandatory need.

operations.name: Configurable Color-Coded Capacity Status
operations.description: The system shall display capacity status using green, yellow, and red indicators based on library-configured capacity thresholds. The configuration shall define the numeric boundary for each status, with green below the yellow boundary, yellow from that boundary to the red boundary, and red at or above the red boundary. Acceptance testing shall verify the displayed status immediately below, at, and above each configured boundary.

operations.name: Staff Workflow Analysis
operations.description: The system shall provide reports that allow authorized staff users and managers to review staff workflow by selected library, staff member, task type, and reporting period. Reports shall display transaction counts by task type and period, and shall identify the criteria used to produce the results. Acceptance testing shall verify the counts against a reference set of recorded transactions for each selected task type and period.

operations.name: Data Quality Reports
operations.description: The system shall provide reports identifying records with missing required values, invalid codes, or inconsistent relationships between records. Each result shall identify the affected record, the field or relationship that failed validation, and the validation rule. Acceptance testing shall use a reference set containing known examples of each supported issue and verify that the report identifies those examples and does not report valid reference records as failures.

operations.name: Library Capacity Analysis
operations.description: The system shall provide capacity reports for selected libraries and a consolidated view across selected libraries. Reports shall identify each library, the configured capacity measure, the observed value, the capacity limit, and the difference between the observed value and limit. Authorized staff users shall be able to select the reporting scope and period; acceptance testing shall verify displayed values against configured limits and reference inventory data.

operations.priority_rationale: The cited evidence is primarily a draft or email request and does not establish a legal, technical, mandatory, or consistently demanded need. The capability is useful but can be delivered after core reporting.

The collection history capability is requested across multiple sources and supports important board and assessment reporting, but a temporary workaround exists and the evidence does not establish a mandatory constraint.
The cited evidence is primarily a single draft request and does not establish a mandatory, legal, technical, or consistently demanded need; the listed reports can be delivered in a later increment.

operations.reason: Vendor website interfaces and automated vendor data-file integrations are outside the scope established by DIS-002. This requirement would impose the vendor integration capability excluded by that scope decision.

Ingesting and handling vendor-provided EDI data is a vendor data integration capability and is outside the scope established by DIS-002. The system is not required by this specification to integrate vendor data.

operations.name: Edited Record Counts
operations.description: The system shall provide a report counting item and bibliographic record edits during a period selected by an authorized staff user. The report shall identify the selected record type and period and return the count for that combination. Acceptance testing shall compare the reported counts with a reference set of edits whose record types and timestamps are known.

operations.name: Usable Query Designer
operations.description: The system shall provide an interface that allows authorized staff users to design queries across bibliographic, item, patron, transaction, and financial records without requiring specialist technical skills. The interface shall expose the supported fields and query criteria and provide validation feedback for incomplete or invalid criteria. Acceptance testing shall verify that a staff user can create and run a query for each supported record type using the displayed controls.

operations.name: Financial Summary and Library Reports
operations.description: The system shall provide financial reports for finance staff, authorized staff users at libraries, and library directors. Reports shall show patron account balances by patron, home library, and library system; fines and charges by period and charge type; fines waived by period and library; and payments by period, payment instrument, and collection channel. The reports shall support end-of-month and other reporting by identifying the library where a payment was collected and the library to which it is attributed.

operations.name: Library Capacity Distribution Analysis
operations.description: The system shall provide reports showing capacity measures and collection distribution for selected libraries. Authorized staff users shall be able to select libraries and a reporting period and compare each library's configured capacity limit with its observed collection measure. Reports shall identify the measure, limit, observed value, and difference so users can assess distribution and capacity against explicit values.

operations.name: In-Transit Item Reporting
operations.description: The system shall provide an in-transit report combining transit-to and transit-from information, including items in transit to a destination library and items in transit by sending library. The report shall identify items without a recorded arrival whose departure date is more than a configurable number of days ago, with a default threshold of 7 days. Authorized staff users shall be able to view results by library or library system and sort them by due date. The report shall identify item, sending library, destination library, departure date, and arrival status to support delivery coordination and follow-up.

operations.name: Deleted Last-Item Reports
operations.description: The system shall provide a report listing items that were purged even though they were the last item owned within the relevant library system. The report shall identify each item and the affected library system so authorized staff users can review the records and update WorldCat or other external catalog records after the purge.

operations.name: Holds Report Catalog
operations.description: The system shall provide reports for Holds Purchase Alerts, items sent for holds, items received for holds, unfilled holds, annual hold counts, and stale holds awaiting pickup. It shall provide IntraPINES loan reports for the consortium and library systems, with results broken down by those scopes. Each report shall identify its reporting scope and period so authorized staff users can interpret results consistently.

operations.name: Transaction and Circulation Metrics
operations.description: The system shall provide reports of transactions for directors, boards, and report users, including checkouts, check-ins, holds placed, and holds filled. Reports shall show total circulation with separate counts for checkouts, renewals, and uncataloged material circulations. Each report shall identify its reporting period and scope so results can be used to monitor library use and compare circulation measures.

operations.name: Combine Query Criteria
operations.description: The system shall let report users combine query clauses using AND and OR Boolean operators and group clauses. Supported item statuses shall include missing, discard or weed, and damaged, as defined by the Library Automation System status codes. A time-in-status criterion shall mean elapsed time since the item entered its current status, and activity criteria shall include elapsed time since last circulation. Acceptance testing shall verify combined criteria against records with known statuses, status-entry dates, and circulation dates.

operations.name: Email Report Delivery
operations.description: The system shall deliver generated reports by email to one or more recipients entered by a report user or selected from an address book. Before delivery, the report user shall be able to review and change the recipient list. The system shall report whether delivery succeeded or failed for each recipient so report users can verify the delivery outcome.

operations.name: Configurable Inactive Patron Reports
operations.description: The system shall generate a list of patrons with no circulation or electronic activity during a number of days specified by a report user. The report user shall be able to enter any number of days and select presets of 30, 90, 180, or 365 days, with report scope options including library system, home library, and county. The output shall identify the selected inactivity threshold and the patron records meeting it.

operations.name: Report Title Tooltips
operations.description: The system shall display a brief description when an authorized staff user hovers over the title of a report template in the report-selection interface. The description shall identify the template's purpose before the staff user selects it. Acceptance testing shall verify that a configured description appears for each template with a description and that templates without one do not display misleading text.

notes: Operations address all reported blocking issues and the reported minor terminology, vagueness, and traceability issues. Exact legal provisions and retention schedules were not supplied, so the revised compliance requirements require the project to identify and approve those references rather than invent them.
